tests/hooks/test-mtk-doctor-stop-hooks.s.description: Hook test for mtk-doctor Stop-hook registration accounting, the double-wiring WARN, and the stale plugin-cache-versions WARN (issue #60)

tests/hooks/test-manifest-preflight.sh.description: Hook test for manifest-preflight.sh — missing modify targets, relocated files, absent patterns, sibling naming and companion conventions

tests/hooks/test-collateral-guard.sh.description: Hook test for collateral-guard.sh — CRLF rewrites, undeclared lockfile churn, asset-set regeneration, and the declared and clean cases that must stay silent

scripts/build-context-pack.sh.description: Writes the per-run context pack (.mtk/workflows/<uuid>/context-pack.md): commands, the stack skill's ORM/data-layer and framework rules, constitution critical rules, applicable rule files for the diff, selected coding-guideline sections, EXTRACTED principles and matching lessons

references/mtk-file-resolution.md.description: Canonical MTK root resolution (MTK_HELPER_ROOT, then the load-time substituted plugin root, then project, then plugin-cache find) that entry-point skills point at instead of repeating the block

references/spec-sidecar-manifest.md.description: Full field reference for the spec's JSON sidecar (docs/specs/<date>-<slug>.json) — allowed values, coverage claims, conditional descopes, downstream plan/implement sections — read by spec-driven-development when authoring or amending a sidecar
